title: Store Systems Glossary — steward-approved terms
count: 12 terms of ≈180 in the store glossary

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: Collibra business glossary · store operations steward council

rows: Transaction log — the sealed, sequence-checked journal of every register event; the legal record of sale, retained 7 years
Local tender approval taken when the acquirer is unreachable, bounded by floor limits and velocity caps; deferred to the network on restore
Point-to-Point Encryption — card data encrypted inside the PIN pad at read; POS and store network never see the PAN, shrinking PCI scope
The store keeps selling through WAN loss — stand-in auth plus store-and-forward TLOG; the design goal is zero lost tenders
Maximum tender amount approvable offline without the acquirer ($500 credit-class); above it the sale requires another tender
Associates with mPOS handhelds ring up customers waiting in line; ≈3,500 devices deployed for peak periods
Back-room function reconciling drawers, safes, and deposits against TLOG tender totals every night
Corporate 3-way match of tender vs authorization vs TLOG before sales post to finance; exceptions route back to the store
Pro/B2B charge account billed on terms rather than tendered at the lane; quotes and tax-exempt handling ride the Pro Desk
Scheduled partial inventory count (≈40k/store/yr) that corrects perpetual on-hand without closing the store
Return without proof of purchase — scored by the AP-fraud service against ID-keyed history before refund tender is allowed
Edge pattern that queues sealed transactions locally (72-hr buffer) and replays them in order when the WAN returns
